name: KB Recall
description: Before-prompt recall over a local Cohere-embedded notes index. No local model, no shell exec — reads the index file and calls Cohere's hosted embed API directly.
security-notes: Reads secrets.env directly for COHERE_API_KEY (the gateway process has no provider env vars available to plugins). Calls api.cohere.com over HTTPS with a hard timeout. No shell execution, no filesystem writes.
privacy-notes: Injects note snippets into hidden prompt context only, scoped to the agents listed in config.agents.
